title: Shi'er lü
description: Set of notes used in Chinese music
extract: Shi'er lü is a standardized gamut of twelve notes used in ancient Chinese music. It is also known, rather misleadingly, as the Chinese chromatic scale; it was only one kind of chromatic scale used in ancient Chinese music. The shi'er lü uses the same intervals as the Pythagorean scale, based on 3:2 ratios. The gamut or its subsets were used for tuning and are preserved in bells and pipes.
